dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: We can rule out temperature and moisture, so it must be a problem with the soil...

dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: I'm Djarkutan, a researcher from Amurta. I'm here to conduct research on tea trees.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You certainly have a broad range of topics.

dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's not like I had any other choice! The more unusual a subject is, the easier it is to write a paper on it.

dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: Tea tree transplantation, for example. Practically no one in the Akademiya is paying attention to it, so I have no rivals on the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: For some reason... The tea trees we bring over to Sumeru never survive.

dialogues.speaker: Djarkutan
dialogues.text: After much thought, I feel that the reason must be the soil. Unfortunately, I never understood my geology and hydrology classes, and starting from scratch now is... difficult...
